60695065.title: LIV_(nightclub)
60695065.extract:
## History
The Fontainebleau Miami Beach hotel, where LIV is housed, has a musical background dating back to the mid-20th century, with its Tropigala Lounge previously hosting performers such as Elvis Presley and Frank Sinatra. The site of LIV was formerly known as the La Ronde Room in the 1950s.

LIV opened in 2008 following a $1 billion renovation of the Fontainebleau hotel. It was developed by the Miami Marketing Group (MMG), with David Grutman as a partner. In 2017, the club underwent a $10 million renovation. In September 2024, LIV became the first nightclub equipped with an L-Acoustics L Series loudspeaker system.

A second LIV venue opened at the Fontainebleau Las Vegas in 2023, featuring similar design elements including state-of-the-art sound and lighting systems. The Las Vegas location has hosted events such as DJ residencies and post-event parties for major sporting occasions.

## Venue
LIV Miami occupies more than 18,000 square feet within the Fontainebleau Miami Beach hotel. It includes a main dance floor, three full-service bars, VIP tables, and private skyboxes. The club operates from Wednesday to Sunday, typically from 11 p.m. to 5 a.m. Music genres played include hip hop, house, rock, and electronic dance music, with live artist presentations.

The Las Vegas counterpart features a multilevel layout with VIP suites, a video wall, and advanced audio-visual technology.

## Ownership and operations
LIV is owned and operated by David Grutman through Groot Hospitality, which evolved from the Miami Marketing Group. Grutman has expanded the brand beyond nightlife into other hospitality ventures.

## Notable events and performers
LIV Miami has hosted numerous events, including Lil Wayne's post-prison release party in 2010. The club regularly features DJs such as David Guetta and Calvin Harris. In December 2025, it served as the venue for open workouts and professional boxing matches during the fight week for the Jake Paul vs. Anthony Joshua bout, organized by Most Valuable Promotions and streamed on Netflix Sports YouTube. Other events have included celebrity appearances during Art Basel, such as Leonardo DiCaprio in 2025.

The club has been associated with various incidents, including reports of unusual occurrences since its opening. LIV has appeared in DJ Mag's Top 100 Clubs rankings, including in 2025.

LIV Nightclub At Fontainebleau Miami Beach Equipped With L-Acoustics
====================================================================

*   [September 18, 2024](https://www.prosoundweb.com/2024/09/18/)

*   [![Image 10: Picture of PSW Staff](https://www.prosoundweb.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/09/Default-Author-150x150.jpg) PSW Staff](https://www.prosoundweb.com/author/psw-staff/)

 Two-story, 1,000-capacity venue becomes the world’s first nightclub to be outfitted with a new L Series loudspeaker system installed by Miami-based L-Acoustics Certified Provider Unreal-Systems. 

LIV at Fontainebleau Miami Beach recently became the world’s first nightclub to be outfitted with a new [L-Acoustics](http://www.unreal-systems.com/) L Series loudspeaker system installed by Miami-based L-Acoustics Certified Provider [Unreal-Systems](http://www.unreal-systems.com/) in a sonic upgrade for the 1,000-capacity, two-story venue.

“Seeing that the world’s top music festivals — including Miami’s own Ultra, Coachella, Lollapalooza, and many others — use L-Acoustics loudspeaker systems, we wanted to offer our guests and performers a professional sound system that was every bit on par with those top-shelf PAs,” says David Grutman, owner of Groot Hospitality. “In fact, we’ve gotten so many A-list artist requests for L-Acoustics monitor systems — better known as ‘Texas headphones’ — that we knew we needed to further invest in LIV and make the upgrade to our house system. There is nothing else on the market that can touch the exceptional fidelity, high-energy impact, and rider-acceptability of L-Acoustics, and I know that we’re going to upgrade the experience for our DJs and clubgoers.”

The new sound design features four hangs of L2D enclosures, each positioned above a corner of the main dancefloor area. Powered by LA7.16i amplified controllers, two of the hangs serve as main left and right arrays flanking the DJ performance area at one end of the room, while two more border the main stage/lounge located on the opposite end. Here, left and right arrays of one KS21 subwoofer over two A15 Wide also serve as a stage-fill system.

Seven KS28 subs, end-stacked in three clusters on the floor at the main-stage end of the room and driven by LA12X amplified controllers, join four more KS28 mounted into the face of the DJ platform to supply the room with massive yet tight low-frequency reinforcement. Two LA4X-powered coaxial X8 enclosures flush-mounted into the wall above the KS28 offer a DJ system front fill. Upstairs, a total of six X12 are flown over the six VIP skyboxes overlooking the dance floor, with two more X12 covering the bar area at the back corner of the upper level.

According to LIV technical director and product manager Max Moussier, “The incredibly compact format and clean lines of the new L2D allowed us to integrate them into our space with minimal distraction to our architectural and visual elements. Unlike video and lighting, you don’t actually want people to see the sound system, but you certainly want them to hear and feel it. Our combination of L2D paired with KS28 sounds absolutely earth-shaking, yet incredibly articulate and crisp, both of which are so important to the electronic dance music genre. LIV Miami Beach has always prided itself on offering audiences and artists the very best, and now, with L-Acoustics, the experience here is even better!”

2.title: LIV: One of the world’s best nightclubs in Miami
2.content:
LIV: ONE OF THE WORLD’S BEST NIGHTCLUBS IN MIAMI

For more than 70 years, Miami Beach has been a premier destination where the beautiful, the rich, and the famous come to play. The city is internationally known for attracting jetsetters who come for the white sandy beaches, the growing art scene, and the thriving nightlife.

At the heart of the city’s nightlife world is LIV, a massive 18,000 square foot club located in the iconic Fontainebleau Hotel and Resort. LIV has dominated Miami Beach nightlife culture since it first opened its doors in 2008.

Rolling Stone Magazine named it one of the best dance clubs in America; Nightclub & Bar Magazine placed it at number five in its annual Top 100 Best Clubs in the Country list for 2014; and Askmen.com gave it the number two spot as the best club in the world.

![Image 1: Upscale and elegant nightclub with plush white seating areas and blue lights](https://www.damnfinelife.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/08LIV0025.jpg)

Celebrities like Leonardo Dicaprio, George Clooney, and Sean Penn have all been guests and they don’t scratch the surface of LIV’s long list of famous faces. Actors, musicians, politicians, and even royalty all go there. Prince Harry of England was spotted at the club earlier this year.

Among the world class DJ elite who have performed at LIV are Calvin Harris, Deadmau5, Paul Oakenfold, and Tiesto.

Whether it’s the pulsating music, the flowing libations, or celebrity sightings, LIV has brilliantly created the perfect environment to inspire guests to splurge. The average cocktail at LIV is $20, but that doesn’t compare to the money some will spend for an ultimate night of indulgence.

It’s not uncommon for a LIV VIP to spend $100,000 in one evening. In 2011, Mark Cuban owner of the NBA Dallas Mavericks celebrated their championship win by ordering a $90,000 bottle of Champagne. Rapping sensation Jay-Z was reported to have spent $250,000 for bottles of champagne to celebrate the release of his album “Watch the Throne”. LIV is estimated to have made more than $35 Million in revenue in 2013.

Some would say that LIV’s massive success is rooted in history. Long before the venue was called LIV it was the world renowned Tropigala Lounge and it was once the epicenter of style, fame, and glamour. In the 50’s and 60’s it was the La Ronde Room which was graced with names like Frank Sinatra, Sammy Davis Jr., Ann Miller, Elvis Presley and Tony Bennett. Historic as it is brilliant, LIV is on par to eclipse the fame and success of the original nightclub.

In 2008, the Fontainebleau completed a billion dollar renovation that celebrated the genius of the hotels original architect Morris Lapidus. Though the subject of outrage when it was created, Lapidus’ building is now an enduring architectural masterpiece and his brilliance was not ignored in the rebirth of the space that is now LIV.A team of international architects, designers and project managers infused the space with a modern and sophisticated style while paying homage to the globular architecture that assisted in putting the resort on the map.

![Image 2: Luxurious nightclub interior features plush seating, a spacious dance floor, and a dynamic lighting system with a blue and purple color scheme](https://www.damnfinelife.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/08LIV0049.jpg)

![Image 3: The interior of a nightclub features blue neon lights on the ceiling, couches, and dark wood furniture](https://www.damnfinelife.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/08LIV0061.jpg)

The clubs multi-layered, nearly circular design allows for maximum movement from room to room and emerges from Lapidus’ daring designs that epitomized a concept of setting a stage where everyone who enters will play a part. The entrance has a long sweeping staircase that leads down the main dance floor and the front of the DJ booth.

The club can comfortably accommodate 1000 guests. There are three full service bars and six private sky boxes for guests that want to see but not be seen. The LED color mixing domed rooftop and more than 50 fixtures of intelligent lighting throughout, contributes to LIV’s reputation as being cream of the crop in the nightlife universe. In true Miami Beach fashion, the club is open from 10pm – 5am, Thursday through Sunday with different music formats on each night. Saturday is LIV’s biggest night and hundreds of people crowd the lobby each week hoping to get in. Those that are lucky enough to get past the velvet ropes are in for a spectacular night.

The Nine Weirdest Things to Ever Happen Inside LIV
==================================================

 In just a short period of time, LIV has become a near-unparalleled hegemonic force in Miami nightlife and culture. Since the club’s 2008 opening within the foundations of the Fontainebleau Hotel, LIV has grown considerably from operating solely as Miami’s premiere den of upper crust hedonism. As its world-famous clientele... 

By [Zach Schlein](https://www.miaminewtimes.com/author/zach-schlein/)June 7, 2016

![Image 4: Carbonatix Pre-Player Loader](https://gamalpha.com/images/tts-pre-loader.gif)
Audio By Carbonatix

In just a short period of time, LIV has become a near-unparalleled hegemonic force in Miami nightlife and culture. Since the club’s 2008 opening within the foundations of the Fontainebleau Hotel, LIV has grown considerably from operating solely as Miami’s premiere den of upper crust hedonism. As its world-famous clientele can attest to, LIV is an international destination, a safe place where your favorite rapper can wreck the dance floor while your most beloved basketball player indiscriminately burns through several hundred dollars’ worth of champagne.

But as anyone who has ever watched a VH1 _Behind the Music_ documentary knows, it takes more than drug and drink-fueled debauchery to reach the top. Beyond the grit and moxie necessary to make it in the cutthroat Miami club scene, it also takes a fair bit of insanity. You don’t get to be consistently ranked as one of the world’s top clubs without offering something resembling an unforgettable experience.

And when people let loose and champagne flows, strange shit is likely to go down. Below, we have compiled the nine weirdest things to have ever happened at LIV. While some of these incidents have made us laugh and some have made us cringe, each has managed to make _New Times_ drop our collective jaw and run to our keyboards.

**9.When Eric Butkiewicz gave Miami its most American mug shot ever.**

 Ah, America: a wonderful place where citizens enjoy the privilege of choosing between a malleable corporate shill and a bigoted quasi-fascist to lead the country for the next four years. Isn’t it grand? We Americans have a proud tradition of annually celebrating our freedoms on our national day of independence, July 4. However, on July 4, 2012, one LIV attendee may have embraced America’s free market principles a bit too zealously.Clad in red, white and blue face paint demonstrating his love for the good ol‘ US of A, then-31-year-old[Eric Oram Butkiewicz was arrested by Miami Beach police](https://www.miaminewtimes.com/news/eric-butkiewicz-man-in-american-flag-face-mug-shot-was-arrested-for-selling-xanax-at-club-liv-on-july-4-6523328) for peddling Xanax during LIV’s fourth of July festivities. As detailed in the police report, Butkiewicz told officers the following: “I possibly have three Xanax bars in my possession.” Ever the cunning entrepreneur, Butkiewicz actually had 13 in his possesion. For embodying both the proud patriotic ideals and adventurous spirit that have made our country great, we salute Butkiewicz for being the rebel we need, although perhaps not the one we deserve. (_Miami New Times_ does not endorse the sale or consumption of illegal narcotics.)

**8.When LIV decided to make a music video.**

 In the age of Instagram and Beyoncé’s “Flawless,” the value of knowing and displaying one’s self-worth has never been a more a prized trait in our society. Now, there’s nothing wrong with a little vanity. After all, it’s commonly accepted that good self-esteem helps promote a good life. [But then you get videos like “We LIV Every Night,”](https://www.miaminewtimes.com/music/liv-made-a-music-video-and-its-everything-you-expect-8290885)a music video assembled by LIV to celebrate the deluge of alcohol and titties (dear god, so many titties) that come with partying at LIV.Sometimes the very act of living in Miami can make one feel a bit inadequate, and videos as loud as “We LIV Every Night” aren’t quite helping the matter. You know something has gone awry when Ja Rule, an artist who gained notoriety for literally shouting his hooks and choruses, was able to pen a more subtle paean to living it up in his beloved single… “Livin’ It Up.”

**7. When Calvin Harris went absolutely off on a heckler.**

 As debates regarding Calvin Harris’ artistic integrity have waxed and waned, one thing that has remained constant is Harris’ absurdly large personal fortune. The Scottish DJ and hitmaker – who rakes in tens of millions on an annual basis by pandering to man’s most basic sonic instincts – is a LIV regular, having soundtracked several evenings in Miami’s most decadent club.Unfortunately for Harris, stupid huge amounts of money don’t automatically equate to success in the ears of all of his listeners. This became apparent in 2013 [when a LIV patron implored Harris to play “something original.”](https://www.miaminewtimes.com/music/calvin-harris-calls-heckler-dumb-fucking-bitch-at-liv-miami-6462927) Despite having countless wads of money with which to wipe away his tears and conceal his bruised ego, Harris instead opted to lash out, referring to the heckler in the process as a “dumb fucking bitch.”Yikes!After spitting on a particularly abrasive concertgoer, Pink Floyd co-vocalist and lyricist Roger Waters was able to sublimate the incident into his grandest conceptual work, 1979’s _The Wall._ Three years removed from his regrettable choice of words, we’re still waiting on Harris’ own angsty masterpiece.

**6. When the UM football team decided to have a fashion show at LIV.**

**### Related

*   [Review: Creed Preaches Unity at Hard Rock Live](https://www.miaminewtimes.com/music/review-creed-preaches-unity-to-miami-fans-at-hard-rock-live-40510776/)

advertisement**
There are few things in this world we find as exciting as corporate synergy, except for maybe the release of new Marvel films or that glorious time of year when McDonald’s trots out the McRib. So when the University of Miami and Adidas[teamed up last July to throw a blowout bash at LIV](http://www.cbssports.com/college-football/news/look-miami-unveils-new-patterned-adidas-uniforms-at-club-liv/) in commemoration of their corporate sponsorship, well, shucks, we could hardly contain ourselves.We’re aware that it may seem odd for the University of Miami, a private research university, to have celebrated a lucrative deal in a venue that most of its attendees couldn’t legally enter. We also know that some of you may find it questionable that neither UM nor Adidas publicly disclosed the details of the 12-year apparel deal reportedly worth upwards of $90 million.What’s important to remember is that at the end of the day, such an agreement is meant only to do what’s best for the student body of UM at large, not just the school’s athletic department, or its myriad corporate sponsors, or its well-compensated coaches, or the thousands of Canes fans ready to drop mad money on the newest merchandise. Hey, at least we got a Pusha T and DJ Don Cannon double-bill out of the deal.

**5. When Instagram douche king Dan Blizerian allegedly kicked a woman in the face.**

In December 2014, professional douchebag and likely Trump voter [Dan Blizerian may or may not have kicked a woman in the face at LIV](https://www.miaminewtimes.com/news/dan-bilzerian-king-of-instagram-wont-face-charges-for-allegedly-kicking-womans-face-at-liv-7548447). After cell phone footage purporting to show Blizerian bringing down his foot on a female clubgoer at LIV emerged, it was reported that he was banned from the club for life.The following March, Miami Beach police announced that they would not be pursuing a case against Blizerian. According to a recent _GQ_ profile, however, the alleged victim may still take legal action against Blizerian.

**4. When Joaquin Phoenix brought his insane performance art to LIV.**

For reasons too numerous to list here, we sincerely wish that we could place actor Joaquin Phoenix’s rap performance and subsequent brawl at LIV within our top three. Sadly, there’s one blatant element that keep it out of the running: the fact that it was manufactured.Don’t get us wrong, watching a disheveled, probably pungent Phoenix stumble over bars and bragging about the $1 million in his bank account is a sight to behold unto itself. That being said, with the entire event having been staged in service of Phoenix’s misguided mockumentary _I’m Still Here_, it lacks the spontaneity and sincerity that makes the following entries – and indeed, LIV – so special.

**3. The saga of Lil Wayne and Birdman.**

 Some of history’s most beloved tales have concerned the torrid affairs of on-again, off-again lovers:_Jane Eyre_. (500) _Days of Summer_. Birdman & Lil Wayne?Although not lovers in the romantic sense (and also not fictional), few modern relationships have captured the hearts and minds of Americans in the manner the former Cash Money associates have managed to. No good love story is complete without a recurring setting, and LIV has obliged time and again to set the stage.Since Wayne’s initial tweets about the drama surrounding _Tha Carter V_‘s release in late 2014, the conflict between the former mentor/mentee duo has resembled nothing less than a hip-hop Cold War. If there was an event that could qualify as this saga’s Cuban Missile Crisis, it would surely be when Birdman and his associates reportedly threw water bottles at Wayne during rapper Jim Jones’ birthday party at LIV. Conversely, a period of détente emerged this past January when Wayne and Birdman took to LIV’s stage together to publicly squash their beef.Even though relations between the two hip-hop titans have chilled once more since then, we’re still holding out hope for a future warm, tearful embrace tastefully juxtaposed against LIV’s shimmering ceiling.

**2. When Diddy punched Drake outside LIV.**

Since his meteoric rise in 2011 with _Take Care_, Canadian meme and occasional rapper Drake has generated more than his fair share of ridiculous headlines. Perhaps the most ridiculous came in 2014, when news broke that [Drake was sent to the hospital following an altercation with P. Diddy outside of LIV](https://www.miaminewtimes.com/music/diddy-punches-drake-at-liv-miami-6445458).For the briefest of moments, it seemed as though Drake may have finally earned something approaching street cred. What could he have possibly done to earn the ire of Sean Puffy Combs Daddy, one of the most prominent figures in the violent East Coast-West Coast hip-hop rivalry of the ’90s? Other than acting upon a golden opportunity – in this case, a passed-over and incredibly dope beat – not much. In all fairness to Puff Daddy, if we felt that we had gotten screwed out of “0 to 100 / The Catch Up,” we’d be pretty pissed as well. Last week saw Drake reignite the beef with a number of not-so-subtle subliminals towards Diddy on his new track, “4PM in Calabasas.” Until we read further developments elsewhere, we’ll be keeping our eye on the entrance to LIV.

**1. When Cuba Gooding Jr. went full _Jerry Maguire_.**

 Many of LIV’s regulars are also the type to dominate the tabloids and command a legion of devoted followers. It’s these powerful few who have thrown drinks, unsavory slurs, and fisticuffs over the past eight years in the unacknowledged but widely understood battle for LIV infamy. Given the power players and stakes involved, one would think that a Kanye West or a Madonna would be behind LIV’s most ridiculous moment. Hell, maybe they’d be a Florida native, buoyed by all of the insanity and narcissism that entails (as a matter of fact, Ariana Grande would be an excellent contender). But, no – leave it to none other than Cuba Gooding, Jr. to come in and fuck things up for everybody else.A March 7 YouTube video titled “Cuba Gooding Jr Lit As Fuck At Club Liv Nightclub In Miami (Nigga Tried To Eat A Phone lol)” tells the story better than we ever could. Having long ago shed his shirt for the purpose of achieving dance nirvana, Gooding most certainly does get lit as fuck, and also comes dangerously close to eating someone’s phone.

29.content:
Miami is home to some of the world’s most iconic nightclubs, but one venue stands above the rest, continually attracting an elite crowd of celebrities, partygoers, and music enthusiasts. [**LIV Nightclub**](https://miamiviptables.com/en/club/liv-miami), located at the luxurious Fontainebleau Hotel in Miami Beach, has been a staple of the city’s nightlife scene since it opened its doors in 2008. Known for its upscale vibe, high-energy performances, and star-studded atmosphere, LIV is often described as the epitome of Miami nightlife. Whether you’re looking to dance the night away or rub shoulders with the rich and famous, LIV promises an experience like no other.

In this review, I’ll take a deep dive into what makes LIV one of the most sought-after nightclubs in Miami. We’ll explore its unique atmosphere, crowd, music, and design, and score each element to give you a complete picture of what a night at LIV is truly like.

![Image 1: Nightclub with a crowd of people on the dance floor and bright laser lights illuminating the room](https://mistnightclub.net/wp-content/uploads/2024/12/LIV.webp)

### A Quick Overview of LIV Nightclub

Located inside the iconic **Fontainebleau Miami Beach**, LIV Nightclub has set the standard for luxury and exclusivity in the Miami nightclub scene. This 18,000-square-foot venue is not just a club; it’s an experience. With its stunning decor, world-class DJs, and a constant stream of VIPs, LIV has become the go-to destination for anyone looking to enjoy a lavish night out. The club offers a blend of high-end elegance with a party atmosphere that keeps people dancing until dawn.

LIV’s reputation for throwing unforgettable parties is unrivaled, and its lineup of top DJs, lavish events, and celebrity sightings continue to make it a hotspot. But beyond the glitter and glamour, what truly sets LIV apart? Let’s break it down.

* * *

### Scoring Breakdown: A Detailed Review of LIV Nightclub

To fully assess what LIV offers, we’ll break down the review into various categories, each contributing to the overall clubbing experience. Let’s dive into what makes LIV Nightclub so special and why it has remained a premier destination for Miami’s party scene for over a decade.

* * *

#### 1. **Atmosphere: 9/10**

The atmosphere at LIV is one of its strongest selling points. From the moment you step into the club, you’re enveloped in an aura of luxury. The sleek, modern design combined with the high-end lighting and sound creates a captivating ambiance that makes you feel like you’ve entered another world. The design is both glamorous and intimate, with every inch of the space crafted to elevate the party experience.

The crowd at LIV tends to be high-energy, with a mix of local Miamians, international visitors, and Hollywood celebrities. It’s not uncommon to see famous faces mingling in the VIP sections or DJ booths, adding to the allure of the club. The crowd is always impeccably dressed, which is part of LIV’s charm. The club attracts a crowd that’s not only there to party but to be seen.

At any given night, LIV feels like a celebration of wealth, beauty, and music. There’s a palpable excitement in the air, with guests eagerly anticipating the performances and DJ sets. However, the size of the club—spanning multiple levels—ensures that it never feels too crowded, even when it’s packed. The space is well-organized, and you’ll find areas to enjoy the music, socialize, and relax, regardless of the crowd size.

* * *

#### 2. **Music: 9.5/10**

Music is the beating heart of any nightclub, and LIV absolutely delivers in this department. The club is known for attracting top-tier DJs from all over the world, and the musical offerings vary from house and EDM to hip-hop and pop. LIV is unique in that it successfully blends multiple genres, ensuring that there’s something for everyone.

The club frequently hosts big-name DJs such as **Calvin Harris**, **David Guetta**, **Avicii**, and **Alesso**, to name just a few. LIV’s reputation as the place where EDM and commercial pop music collide makes it a hotspot for fans of mainstream dance music. However, it’s also known for its diverse range of musical acts, offering everything from hip hop nights to special performances by live artists.

The sound system at LIV is nothing short of incredible. The bass hits hard, and the acoustics are designed to envelop the entire room in music. Whether you’re near the stage or chilling in a private VIP booth, the sound will make you feel like you’re part of the show.

The overall vibe is one of unbridled energy—when the music hits, so does the crowd. People are there to dance, to lose themselves in the rhythm, and to be part of a larger-than-life experience. LIV’s music selection is both familiar and thrilling, and the crowd is always in sync with the DJ, moving as one collective entity.

* * *

#### 3. **Crowd: 8.5/10**

The crowd at LIV is what you’d expect from a world-renowned nightclub in the heart of Miami. It’s glamorous, trendy, and packed with partygoers who are as much about looking the part as they are about dancing the night away. On any given night, you’ll see a range of people—from well-dressed locals and international jet-setters to A-list celebrities and influencers. It’s a space where fashion and fun intersect, and everyone is there to experience the ultimate nightlife event.

The crowd is sophisticated and lively, but it also has an air of exclusivity. LIV attracts a well-heeled crowd who are looking for more than just a night of dancing—they want to be part of the VIP experience, whether it’s by getting a bottle of champagne in the VIP section or getting up close to the DJ booth. The mix of partygoers is what gives LIV its charm. It’s not just a club; it’s a spectacle.

However, this can also be a downside for some. LIV is a high-end club, and with that comes a certain level of elitism. The VIP areas are strictly reserved for those who are willing to drop serious cash, and the entrance lines can sometimes feel like an exclusive club within a club. If you’re not willing to spend on bottle service or secure a VIP table, expect a more standard nightlife experience. But for those looking to mingle with Miami’s finest, LIV provides an unparalleled atmosphere.

* * *

#### 4. **Sound and Lighting: 9.5/10**

One of the standout features of LIV Nightclub is its incredible sound and lighting system. The club boasts a custom-designed **Pioneer sound system** that pumps out crystal-clear audio, ensuring that every beat is perfectly delivered throughout the venue. Whether you’re standing on the main floor, in the balcony area, or in the VIP sections, the sound is consistently immersive and loud enough to get you moving.

The lighting at LIV is just as impressive as the sound. The club features an array of intelligent lighting systems, LED displays, and laser shows that keep the energy high. The lighting isn’t just functional; it’s an integral part of the experience. It works in perfect harmony with the music, amplifying the emotional highs of each track and syncing with the rhythm of the crowd. The colorful lasers, strobe lights, and vivid projections create a dynamic visual landscape, immersing you in a sensory overload of music, light, and movement.

What sets LIV apart is how the lighting and sound are used to create a theatrical experience. It’s not just about the music and the party—it’s about a performance. The DJs, the lights, the sound, and the crowd all come together to create something much larger than life. LIV is a nightclub that knows how to make every moment feel like a celebration.

* * *

#### 5. **Venue Design: 9/10**

LIV’s design is sleek, sophisticated, and well thought out. The nightclub is located in the Fontainebleau Miami Beach, a luxury hotel that has been a staple of Miami’s glamorous history. The club’s design reflects that same level of elegance, with an upscale vibe that’s immediately apparent the moment you walk through the doors.

The venue itself is expansive, with multiple levels that allow for different experiences. The **main dance floor** is expansive, surrounded by towering columns and impressive design elements that scream luxury. Above the floor, you’ll find a **balcony area** where you can catch a birds-eye view of the action below. The VIP areas are lavishly designed, with plush seating, private booths, and bottle service that creates a true sense of exclusivity.

One of the most interesting elements of LIV’s design is the **massive LED display** that sits behind the DJ booth. This is where the visual magic happens, creating mesmerizing visuals that add to the immersive experience. The club also uses a mix of both open and enclosed spaces, ensuring that there’s always a vibe suited to your mood. Whether you want to be right in the middle of the action or have a more private area to watch the performance, LIV offers both.

* * *

### Final Thoughts: Is LIV Nightclub Worth It?

[**LIV Nightclub**](https://miamiviptables.com/en/club/liv-miami) is a beacon of Miami’s glamorous nightlife scene. From its lavish design and world-class DJs to its high-energy crowd and immersive sound and lighting, LIV offers one of the most high-profile nightlife experiences in the world. It’s a place where the party never stops, where the music moves you, and where you’re surrounded by the best of Miami’s elite.

However, with its exclusivity comes a price. LIV can be expensive, with VIP experiences and bottle service pushing the cost of a night out into the high-end stratosphere. The club can also feel a bit intimidating for those who aren’t accustomed to its high-profile clientele.

Still, LIV remains a must-visit destination for those looking to experience Miami at its finest. Whether you’re seeking a place to party until the early hours or simply want to soak in the glamorous atmosphere, LIV delivers in spades.

**Final Score: 9/10** — LIV Nightclub is the epitome of Miami nightlife: glamorous, energetic, and unforgettable. It’s worth experiencing at least once, but be prepared for a high-end, celebrity-filled experience that sets the bar for luxury nightlife.

LIV opened its doors in 2008 as part of the grand re-opening of the Fontainebleau Hotel, which underwent a $1 billion renovation. Over the years, it has maintained its status as one of the top nightclubs in the world, consistently ranking high on industry lists.

LIV’s VIP area is where the city’s elite come to see and be seen, making it a must-visit for anyone looking to indulge in Miami’s nightlife at its finest.

### Notable Events and Celebrities

LIV has played host to countless celebrity events over the years, solidifying its reputation as a playground for the rich and famous. From Super Bowl parties to after-parties for major award shows, LIV has seen it all. Celebrities like Kim Kardashian, LeBron James, and Leonardo DiCaprio have all been spotted at LIV, adding to the club’s allure.

One of the most talked-about events in LIV’s history was Lil Wayne’s homecoming party in 2010, following his release from prison. The event drew massive crowds and cemented LIV’s status as the go-to spot for major celebrations.

### Conclusion: LIV Nightclub

LIV Nightclub in Miami is more than just a nightlife destination; it’s a cultural landmark that embodies the essence of Miami’s vibrant, luxurious, and diverse scene. Whether you’re a local or a visitor, a night at LIV is an unforgettable experience that captures the magic of Miami Beach. From its stunning design to its world-class entertainment, LIV continues to set the standard for nightlife, not just in Miami, but around the world. Superstar DJ debuts Fontainebleau residency after Super Bowl
============================================================

Calvin Harris plays LIV at Fontainebleau after the Super Bowl on Feb. 11.

[![Image 12: John Katsilometes](https://neon.reviewjournal.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/Katsilometes-John-20250625_sm03.jpg?w=100&h=100&crop=1)](https://neon.reviewjournal.com/staff/john-katsilometes/)

By [John Katsilometes](https://neon.reviewjournal.com/staff/john-katsilometes/)

/Las Vegas Review-Journal

 January 30, 2024 - 12:23 pm 

[](https://www.facebook.com/sharer/sharer.php?u=https%3A%2F%2Fneon.reviewjournal.com%2Fpost%2F2990586)[![Image 13: icon-x](https://res.cloudinary.com/review-journal/image/upload/f_auto,c_scale,w_50/v1690838126/rj-project/social_x_icon_black.png)](https://twitter.com/intent/tweet?url=https%3A%2F%2Fneon.lvrj.com%2Fpost%2F2990586&via=neonlasvegas&text=Superstar%20DJ%20debuts%20Fontainebleau%20residency%20after%20Super%20Bowl)[](mailto:?&subject=[Shared%20Post]%20Superstar%20DJ%20debuts%20Fontainebleau%20residency%20after%20Super%20Bowl&body=You%20may%20be%20interested%20in%20the%20following%20post:%20https://neon.reviewjournal.com/post/2990586)

Updated January 31, 2024 - 7:38 pm

**Calvin Harris’** residency launch is the Super Bowl’s post-game show.

The superstar producer and DJ is playing LIV Las Vegas on Feb. 11. This is the lid-lifter of his residency at LIV and LIV Beach, operated by Groot Hospitality. Harris will toggling his dates between the nightclub and beach venues. His schedule is to be announced.

Story continues after advertisement

“Can’t wait to get back to Las Vegas, LIV looks amazing and I’m excited to be part of what’s going on there!” Harris said in a statement. After Super Bowl Sunday, Harris will perform select dates through 2024. Tickets, VIP packages and intel at [livnightclub.com/las-vegas/](http://livnightclub.com/las-vegas/).

According to a description of the production in Tuesday’s announcement, “Fans can expect an audio-visual journey through Harris’ expansive catalog of hits and collaborations at Fontainebleau Las Vegas’ flagship nightlife and daylife venues.” LIV Beach debuts in March, and Harris plays the dayclub March 16.

Groot Hospitality’ founder **David Grutman**says, “Together with Fontainebleau Las Vegas, it’s a huge honor to welcome Calvin Harris to his residency at LIV and LIV Beach. Calvin is one of the most respected in the industry, and he knows how to put on an incredible show.”

#### A Night at LIV at the Fontainebleau

There are few things that compare to a night out at LIV. Grab your friends, dress to impress, and dance and drink the night away with some of Miami's most beautiful people. When you do, you might even run into a celebrity. Rumor has it LIV is popular amongst famous faces when they're in town like Jonathan Cheban, Drake, Rihanna and Paris Hilton.

#### About LIV

At LIV, you'll get the real Miami nightlife experience. Located on the bottom level of the Fontainebleau Miami Beach Hotel, and occupying more than 18,000 square feet of space, LIV combines an ultra exclusive lounge with a high-energy nightclub.

LIV offers three full-service bars helmed by some of the best mixologists in the business. For the ultimate VIP treatment, guests can reserve up to fifty banquette areas or six private skyboxes, each featuring table service.

#### Hot Parties and DJs

Five nights a week, LIV has some of the hottest DJs and performers on the music scene, from David Guetta and Calvin Harris, to MAKJ, Mr. Mauricio, Luciano, Audien, D-Nice, Burns and more.

#### General Information

LIV is open Wednesdays through Sundays, from 11 p.m. to 5 a.m. It offers VIP tables, private skyboxes, three full-service bars and a lavish main dance floor. Guests must be 21+ with a valid I.D.

Meanwhile, Fontainebleau Miami Beach celebrated the highly anticipated grand opening of the Coastal Convention Center on Wednesday, Dec. 11, 2024. Fontainebleau Development Chairman and CEO Soffer was joined by Fontainebleau Miami Beach executives, community dignitaries, local officials and notable VIPs, and the historic moment was marked with speeches, tours of the convention center, and a ceremonial ribbon cutting.

"When we bought Fontainebleau Miami Beach back in 2005, we purchased this piece of land with it because it was always part of our plan to build something amazing here," said Soffer. "After two years of design and construction, we are excited at the possibilities of what the Coastal Convention Center will bring to the community.”

"Fontainebleau has always been driven by innovation and evolution,” said Soffer. “We set out to be the number one convention hotel in Florida and beyond, and this Coastal Convention Center further cements our dedication to that goal. Our main priorities have always been to do what is best for the city, and to bring jobs and tourism to Miami. Thank you to our incredible teams who helped bring this dream to life, and to my father, Don Soffer, who has always been the visionary of our family."

The event began with a welcome from Fontainebleau Development Chief Operating Officer Philip Goldfarb who stated, "Today we officially open the doors of the Coastal Convention Center, making this is a monumental occasion. This celebration combines the connection between our rich legacy, our dedication to excellence, and the vibrant community which we are very proud to be part of. We are honored to have you here today to witness this historic moment and we appreciate the support of our distinguished guests, and our community of leaders and partners who have played a vital role in bringing this vision to life."

The ceremony, which took place in the Coastal Convention Center's Pearl Ballroom, symbolized the vision for growth, community investment, and commitment to luxury hospitality held by Fontainebleau Miami Beach as the resort nears its 70th anniversary on Dec. 21, 2024. The opening also reinforces the consistent growth and demand for meeting and convention business in South Florida, providing a state-of-the-art facility with world-class hospitality.

"The Coastal Convention Center is an asset for Miami Dade County, and all of South Florida. It is going to open the door for tremendous possibilities for us to attract larger and more flexible events," said David Whitaker, president and CEO of the Greater Miami Convention & Visitors Bureau. "This hotel has always been the crown jewel of Miami Beach, but it didn't stand still, it is constantly evolving, and the Coastal Convention Center is another great example of that evolution."

Designed in partnership with Fontainebleau Development's Executive Vice President of Design John Rawlins, Jeffrey Beers International, and Nichols Architects, the Coastal Convention Center spans five stories and 45,000 square feet, including a spacious 7,000-square-foot rooftop deck. The state-of-the-art Coastal Convention Center caters to both business and leisure events. Located just nine miles from Miami International Airport and 28 miles from Fort Lauderdale-Hollywood International Airport, the Coastal Convention Center will connect to Fontainebleau Miami Beach via sky bridge, perfectly complementing the resort's 200,000 square feet of indoor and outdoor meeting and event space.

"This Coastal Convention Center stands as a testament to the evolution of this amazing city, welcoming business travelers from all over the world to experience best in class design, service, and hospitality, and it is, of course, courtesy of Fontainebleau Miami Beach," said Brittnie Bassant, president and CEO of the Miami Beach Chamber of Commerce. "The economic impact that this center will have will benefit our local businesses, our community, and our entire city. We are thrilled to add the Coastal Convention Center to the landscape of our community. This is the power of partnership and collaboration."

A blend of Golden Era glamour and modern luxury, Fontainebleau Miami Beach merges striking design, contemporary art, music, fashion and history into a vibrant guest experience. A revered landmark and symbol of style and sophistication since its opening in 1954, the resort has 1,504 guestrooms and suites appointed with lavish amenities; the world-renowned LIV Nightclub, 12 restaurants and lounges including AAA Four Diamond signature restaurant Hakkasan and Mirabella, celebrating coastal Italian cuisine; the 40,000-square-foot Lapis Spa; a dramatic oceanfront pool-scape offering lush cabanas; and is home to BleauLive, the innovative concert series that combines intimate performances with memorable weekend escapes.

For more information on Fontainebleau Miami Beach, call 877-512-8002 or visit [www.fontainebleau.com](http://www.fontainebleau.com/).

#### Your Privacy

When you visit our website, we store cookies on your browser to collect information. The information collected might relate to you, your preferences or your device, and is mostly used to make the site work as you expect it to and to provide a more personalized web experience. However, you can choose not to allow certain types of cookies, which may impact your experience of the site and the services we are able to offer. Click on the different category headings to find out more and change our default settings according to your preference. You cannot opt-out of our First Party Strictly Necessary Cookies as they are deployed in order to ensure the proper functioning of our website (such as prompting the cookie banner and remembering your settings, to log into your account, to redirect you when you log out, etc.). For more information about the First and Third Party Cookies used please follow this link.  
[More information](https://cookiepedia.co.uk/giving-consent-to-cookies)

#### Strictly Necessary Cookies

Always Active

These cookies are necessary for the website to function and cannot be switched off in our systems. They are usually only set in response to actions made by you which amount to a request for services, such as setting your privacy preferences, logging in or filling in forms. You can set your browser to block or alert you about these cookies, but some parts of the site will not then work. These cookies do not store any personally identifiable information.

#### Share Or Sale of Personal Data

 Share Or Sale of Personal Data

Under the CPRA, you have the right to opt-out of the sale or sharing of your personal information to third parties. These cookies collect information for analytics and to personalize your experience with targeted ads. You may exercise your right to opt out of the sale or sharing of personal information by using this toggle switch. If you opt out we will not be able to offer you personalized ads and will not hand over your personal information to any third parties. Additionally, you may contact our legal department for further clarification about your rights as a California consumer by using this Exercise My Rights link.If you have enabled privacy controls on your browser (such as a plugin), we have to take that as a valid request to opt-out. Therefore we would not be able to track your activity through the web. This may affect our ability to personalize ads according to your preferences.

If you do not allow these cookies, you will experience less targeted advertising.

Event Info

David Guetta Live at LIV Nightclub – Friday, March 21, 2025

Prepare for an unforgettable night as David Guetta takes over LIV Nightclub at the Fontainebleau Hotel in Miami Beach on Friday, March 21, 2025. As one of the world's most influential DJs and producers, Guetta has been a dominant force in the electronic dance music scene for decades, delivering global hits and high-energy performances that have captivated audiences worldwide.

About David Guetta

Born in Paris, France, David Guetta began his career as a DJ in the late 1980s, playing in local clubs before rising to international prominence. He is renowned for his ability to blend house music with pop, creating chart-topping tracks that resonate with a broad audience. Some of his most notable hits include "Titanium" featuring Sia, "When Love Takes Over" with Kelly Rowland, and "Without You" featuring Usher. Guetta's innovative approach to music production has earned him multiple Grammy Awards and billions of streams across various platforms. His collaborations span a wide range of artists, including Sia, Rihanna, Justin Bieber, and Nicki Minaj, showcasing his versatility and influence in the music industry.

The Event at LIV Nightclub

LIV Nightclub, located within the iconic Fontainebleau Hotel, is synonymous with luxury and world-class entertainment. Known for its vibrant atmosphere and state-of-the-art sound system, LIV offers an unparalleled nightlife experience. On March 21, 2025, the club will host David Guetta for a night that promises to be electrifying. Attendees can expect an upscale environment, cutting-edge light shows, and a crowd of music enthusiasts ready to dance the night away. VIP table reservations are available for those seeking an exclusive experience. Given Guetta's global appeal and the intimate setting of LIV, this event is anticipated to sell out quickly.

Why You Should Attend

Experiencing David Guetta live is more than just attending a concert; it's immersing yourself in a musical journey curated by one of the industry's finest. His ability to read the crowd and deliver a set that keeps energy levels soaring is unparalleled. Whether you're a long-time fan or new to his music, this event offers the opportunity to witness a master at work in one of Miami's premier venues. The combination of Guetta's dynamic performance and LIV's exceptional ambiance ensures a memorable night. Don't miss your chance to be part of this exclusive event. Secure your tickets and prepare for a night of incredible music and unforgettable moments.

Izaak Live at LIV Nightclub – Thursday, April 3, 2025

Event Details:

\- Date: Thursday, April 3, 2025  
\- Time: Doors open at 11:30 PM  
\- Venue: LIV Nightclub, 4441 Collins Ave, Miami Beach, FL 33140  
\- Age Requirement: 21 & over

Experience an electrifying night with Puerto Rican reggaeton sensation Izaak as he takes the stage at LIV Nightclub in Miami Beach on Thursday, April 3, 2025. Known for his dynamic performances and chart-topping hits, Izaak promises an unforgettable evening of Latin urban music.

About Izaak

Born Isaac Ortiz in Gurabo, Puerto Rico, Izaak discovered his passion for music at a young age, singing in his local church. He first gained recognition as a member of the boy band Los Menores before transitioning to a solo career. Izaak has collaborated with notable artists such as Jhayco and Anuel AA, and is best known for hits like "Bby Boo" and its remix featuring Jhayco and Anuel AA. His unique blend of reggaeton and Latin trap has earned him a dedicated following and millions of monthly listeners on platforms like Spotify.

The Venue: LIV Nightclub

As one of Miami's premier nightlife destinations, LIV offers an unparalleled clubbing experience, making it the perfect venue for Izaak's performance.

VIP Table Reservations & Tickets

Enhance your night by reserving a VIP table, which includes premium bottle service, exclusive seating, and prime views of the stage. Given Izaak's rising popularity, VIP tables are expected to sell out quickly. Secure your reservation now through [LIV Nightclub's official event page](https://www.livnightclub.com/miami/event/EVE112156200020250403/izaak/).

General admission tickets are also available. Due to high demand, early purchase is highly recommended to ensure entry.

Dress Code & Entry Requirements

LIV Nightclub maintains a fashionable dress code to complement its upscale environment. Guests are encouraged to dress in stylish, club-appropriate attire. Please note, this event is strictly for guests aged 21 and over; valid identification will be required upon entry.

![Image 1](blob:https://resident.com/48f76619a5bd00ce057f2024dcf38bc1)

LIV at Fontainebleau, consistently ranked one of the top nightlife venues in the world, will undergo a $10 million renovation July 2017, in time for its tenth season.

Melding the allure of the historical Fontainebleau and the future of entertainment, LIV has redefined nightlife on Miami Beach and pioneered the nightlife experience.David Grutman, partner at MMG, has retained acclaimed experiential design firm ICRAVE to oversee the project.  
With over 18,000 square feet of striking architecture, soaring ceilings, vibrant lighting and its iconic dome, LIV continues to set the stage for the ultimate nightlife experience.  
LIV will be updated to reflect the latest in technology and design in the nightlife industry.

"We are in the business of fun and in order to create that experience we need to be focused on every detail.  We can't just say we are the best and have the best without constantly challenging ourselves to do better," says David Grutman. "By updating LIV with the latest technology we can say with confidence that we are creating the next level party."

**The physical and technological upgrades incorporate the latest and greatest available including:**  
• Over 400 digitally controlled LED panels to create choreographed light shows that correspond with music throughout the space  
• A refreshed design aesthetic throughout, including new banquettes, flooring, bars, 'Hollywood squares', and wallcoverings  
•Massive LED feature walls throughout  
•Soaring projection-mapped stage area that creates customizable backdrops within the VIP experience  
• LIV will curate and rotate art by renowned Miami street artists

To refresh the space, ICRAVE focused the redesign on major upgrades to the technology throughout the space. ICRAVE partnered with SJ Lighting to maximize the historic 'bones' of the space and transform the iconic dome and steel truss – affectionately referred to as 'The Spider'. The technological advances will transform LIV into an even more immersive and energetic nightclub environment. The revamped 'spider' and its column support legs will be clad with a state of the art robotically controlled lighting 'chandelier', allowing the space to expand and contract using over 400 moving LED screens raising and lowering to choreographed movements dance inside the iconic dome. This, along with a general refresh of the look and materials, and the introduction of projection mapping in the space, will keep LIV as the go-to club in Miami and beyond.

"We are excited to be part of such an iconic nightlife location that will continue to make an impact on Miami. SJ Lighting's new chandelier piece is going to create a whole new layer to for the experience in this space which will blow some minds." Says Lionel OHayon, ICRAVE.

LIV's footprint stands in the home of the world-renowned Tropigala Lounge, known in the 50's and 60's as the La Ronde Room. Frank Sinatra was the first to illuminate the stage, followed by the likes of Sammy Davis Jr., Ann Miller, Elvis Presley and Tony Bennet. LIV has once again made the space an epicenter for style, fame and glamour.

"Since first opening its doors in 1954, Fontainebleau Miami Beach has been a pioneer in music and entertainment.  It is in our DNA and this renovation will continue to position the resort as the premiere nightlife destination in South Florida," said Philip Goldfarb, President and COO of Fontainebleau Miami Beach.

In order to facilitate the work, LIV will close for the summer during the Fourth of July holiday weekend and reopen September 2017. Please stay tuned for closing and opening schedules.

### About LIV Miami

Melding the allure of the historical Fontainebleau and contemporary entertainment, LIV has redefined nightlife on Miami Beach. The quintessential nightspot, fashioned by David Grutman and Miami Marketing Group, fuses the appeal of an ultra exclusive lounge and a high-energy nightclub. With over 18,000 square feet of striking architectural design and lavish decor, LIV sets the stage for the ultimate nightlife experience. A voyeuristic design throughout the nightclub gives guests a bird's eye view of the celebrities, VIPs and Miami's most beautiful crowd.

4441 Collins Ave, Miami Beach, FL 33140 | [LIVNightclub.com](http://livnightclub.com/) | [305-674-4680](tel:\(305\)%20674-4680)

### About Fontainebleau Miami Beach

A spectacular blend of Golden Era glamour and modern luxury, Fontainebleau Miami Beach merges striking design, contemporary art, music, fashion and history into a vibrant guest experience. A revered landmark and symbol of style and sophistication since its opening in 1954, Fontainebleau Miami Beach boasts 1,504 guestrooms and suites appointed with lavish amenities; the world-renowned LIV™ Nightclub, 12 restaurants and lounges including two restaurants from Chef Michael Mina – StripSteak and Pizza & Burger; two AAA Four Diamond signature restaurants, Scarpetta by Scott Conant and Hakkasan; the 40,000-square-foot Lapis spa with mineral-rich water therapies and invigorating treatments; a dramatic oceanfront pool-scape offering lush cabanas; and is home to BleauLive, the innovative concert series that combines intimate performances with memorable weekend escapes.  For general information or accommodations at Fontainebleau Miami Beach, visit [www.fontainebleau.com](http://www.fontainebleau.com/) or call 1.877.512.8002.

### About ICRAVE

Known for creative, high-energy environments that actively engage visitors, ICRAVE has mastered the art of experience design, melding operational, digital, and physical elements across a spectrum of diverse spaces. Helmed by Lionel Ohayon since 2002, ICRAVE has designed award-winning hospitality, airport, development, and healthcare projects, partnering with high profile brands such as W Hotels, MGM, Disney Dream, Hilton, Memorial Sloan Kettering, Summit Series, and OTG. Spanning a number of industries, ICRAVE's notable projects include Le District, LaGuardia's Delta Terminal C & D, The Summit at Powder Mountain, STK Restaurants, Provocateur, and more.

With expertise in design, strategy, and lighting, ICRAVE is credited with reinventing the modern day airport experience, reimagining cancer care, and transforming New York's Meatpacking District through creating some of the most iconic nightlife of the last decade.

The Definitive Miami Nightlife Experience
-----------------------------------------

### LIV at Fontainebleau, consistently ranked one of the top nightlife venues in the world, reopened after a $10 million renovation to kick off the nightclub's tenth season. LIV has redefined nightlife on Miami Beach and pioneered the nightlife experience. David Grutman, partner at MMG, retained acclaimed experiential design firm ICRAVE to oversee the transformation. With over 18,000 square feet of striking architecture, soaring ceilings, vibrant lighting and its iconic dome. LIV will continue to set the stage for the ultimate nightlife experience.

LIV has been updated to reflect the latest in technology and design in the nightlife industry. The physical and technological upgrades incorporate the latest and greatest available including maximizing the historic ‘bones’ of the space and have transformed the iconic dome and steel truss - affectionately referred to as ‘The Spider’. LIV has become an even more immersive and energetic nightclub environment. This, along with a general refresh of the look and materials, and the introduction of projection mapping in the space, have further cemented LIV as the go-to club in Miami and beyond.

LIV’s footprint stands in the home of the world-renowned Tropigala Lounge, known in the 50’s and 60’s as the La Ronde Room. Frank Sinatra was the first to illuminate the stage, followed by the likes of Sammy Davis Jr., Ann Miller, Elvis Presley and Tony Bennet. LIV has once again made the space an epicenter for style, fame and glamour.

**LIV Nightclub Las Vegas** officially opened its doors in **December 2023**, bringing the iconic Miami nightlife brand to the heart of the **Fontainebleau Resort and Casino** on the Las Vegas Strip. This much-anticipated venue marks a bold West Coast expansion for the legendary **LIV Nightclub**, originally founded in Miami by David Grutman’s Groot Hospitality.

**LIV Las Vegas** brings top-tier DJs, extravagant bottle service, and high-energy parties to the desert. This is already being recognized as one of the hottest new clubs in Las Vegas.

Check out the events calendar for **LIV Nightclub** and other top Vegas clubs on our [**Las Vegas Nightclub and Dayclub Event Calendar**.](https://app.discotech.me/las-vegas/events)

LIV Nightclub Las Vegas
-----------------------

*   LIV nightclub officially opened in December 2023
*   Set in the brand new Fontainebleau Hotel
*   The club is a multilevel venue with a mezzanine level outfitted VIP suites.
*   There is state-of-the-art technology and sound planned with a video wall that features dual-sided LED screens and special effects lighting that moves in a full 360 degrees
*   Expect to see big-name DJs and artists performing here weekly
*   This is set to be the hottest Vegas club in 2024

LIV Nightclub – Frequently Asked Questions
------------------------------------------

### Where is LIV Nightclub located?

LIV Nightclub is located inside the newly opened Fontainebleau Las Vegas at [**2777 S Las Vegas Blvd**](https://www.google.com/maps/place/Fontainebleau+Las+Vegas/@36.1373971,-115.1620103,16z/data=!3m1!4b1!4m9!3m8!1s0x80c8c57ddfb701f5:0xd02b955c78c33b74!5m2!4m1!1i2!8m2!3d36.1373971!4d-115.1594354!16s%2Fm%2F04gkt62?entry=ttu&g_ep=EgoyMDI1MDQyMS4wIKXMDSoJLDEwMjExNDUzSAFQAw%3D%3D), right on the Las Vegas Strip.

### How much is the cover charge at LIV Nightclub Las Vegas?

Cover charge varies depending on the night and performer. Expect **$50–$150 for men** and **$30–$100 for women**. Pricing may increase for major events. **VIP bottle service** costs depend on table location and event.

### How long is the wait at LIV Nightclub?

Lines can get long, especially on weekends and holidays. Arrive **before 11:00 PM** to avoid the rush. During peak times, wait times range from **30 minutes to over an hour**.

### What are LIV Nightclub’s hours of operation?

**Friday – Sunday: 10:00 PM to 4:00 AM** (next day).

### What are the best nights to visit LIV Nightclub?

**Fridays and Saturdays** are the busiest nights, featuring top-tier DJs and the full Vegas nightlife experience.

### What is the dress code at LIV Nightclub Las Vegas?

LIV enforces an upscale nightclub dress code.

*   **Men:** Collared shirts, jeans/slacks, and dress shoes. No sneakers, hats, shorts, or athletic wear.

*   **Women:** Trendy nightlife attire. Avoid overly revealing outfits.

VIP guests may have a bit more flexibility, but **dress to impress** to ensure entry.

### How much do drinks cost at LIV Nightclub?

Expect standard Vegas pricing:

*   **Cocktails:** $18–$25

*   **Beers & shots:** $15–$20
*   **Bottle menu** prices vary by night and table location.

### Who are the resident DJs at LIV Nightclub?

2025 resident DJs include **John Summit, Dom Dolla, David Guetta, Tiësto**, and more.

### What kind of music is played at LIV Nightclub?

LIV primarily features **EDM**, with performances by world-class DJs. Expect occasional **hip-hop nights** and live artist appearances.

### Where can I find LIV Nightclub’s upcoming events and tickets?

Download the [Discotech app](https://link.discotech.me/nh/) to see upcoming events, get on guest lists, book VIP tables, or purchase tickets. You can also check the [Las Vegas Event Calendar](https://app.discotech.me/las-vegas/events) for club lineups.

LIV Nightclub: The Ultimate Playground for the Elite
====================================================

 READ 

[BACK](https://thekaskadeshotel.com/?page_id=569)

Are you ready for the ultimate nightlife experience? Then look no further than LIV Nightclub in [Miami Beach](https://thekaskadeshotel.com/top-10-fun-things-to-do-in-south-beach-miami/). This legendary club has been attracting the elite since it opened in 2008. From the VIP areas to the unmatched bottle service, LIV is the playground of the rich and famous.

VIP Treatment: The Ultimate Luxury Experience
---------------------------------------------

The club offers VIP treatment that is second to none. From the moment you arrive, you will be treated like royalty. The hosts of VIP will take care of your every need and make sure you have the night of your life.

The VIP areas at LIV are the perfect place to be seen. With private tables, comfortable seating and bottle service, you will feel like a true VIP. The areas of VIP are spacious enough for you and your entourage to dance the night away.

LIV has a dress code that adheres to a strict, upscale fashion sense and is known for being the hardest club to get into. The lines outside LIV are unwieldy and only a handful of people are let in once the rope is open. So do your best to get in and you will be very well rewarded.

Bottle Service: The Key to the Ultimate Nightlife Experience
------------------------------------------------------------

Bottle service is the key to the ultimate nightlife experience, and LIV has the best in town. The bottle service’s extensive menu features premium spirits, champagnes and premium liquors. You can choose from a variety of bottle sizes, including magnums and jeroboams.

Bottle service at LIV is not just about the drinks, it’s about the experience. Bottle service is served by dedicated waiters who are knowledgeable about the different spirits and can make recommendations based on your preferences. The presentation of the bottles is also a feast for the eyes, with sparklers and confetti adding to the excitement.

Dress to Impress: The Ultimate Fashion Show
-------------------------------------------

LIV is not only a place to party, but also a place to show off your fashion sense. The dress code at LIV Nightclub is upscale and trendy. Dress to impress and you will blend in with the elite society. Men should wear suit shoes, collared shirts and suit pants. Women should opt for elegant clothes, like cocktail dresses or chic jumpsuits.

The dress code is strictly enforced at LIV, so be sure to abide by it. After all, you do not want to be turned away at the door because of your attire. The dress code adds to the upscale, high-end experience that LIV offers.

World Class DJs: The Ultimate Soundtrack
----------------------------------------

The nightclub is known for its world-class DJs who provide the ultimate soundtrack for your night. The club has a state-of-the-art sound system that delivers clear and crisp sound throughout the club. The DJs spin a variety of music including EDM, hip-hop, and top 40 hits.

The DJs at LIV Nightclub are some of the biggest names in the business. They have DJ’d at some of the biggest clubs and festivals around the world and now they are bringing their talents to LIV Nightclub. Music is the heartbeat of any club, and at LIV Nightclub you are guaranteed an unforgettable night of music and dancing.

Celebrity Sightings: The Ultimate A-list Hangout
------------------------------------------------

LIV is no stranger to celebrity sightings. The club has attracted some of the biggest names in entertainment, from sports stars to Hollywood celebrities. You never know who you’ll see on the dance floor at LIV Nightclub.

The celebrity sightings are what make LIV so attractive. The club has a reputation for being the ultimate A-list hangout, and it’s not hard to see why. The luxurious atmosphere and top-notch amenities make the club a magnet for the elite.

Unsurpassed Atmosphere: The Ultimate Setting
--------------------------------------------

The atmosphere at LIV is second to none. From the moment you enter the club, you are transported into a world of luxury and opulence. The design of the club is elegant and modern, with comfortable seating and stunning lighting to enhance the ambiance.

The design of the club is not the only thing that sets it apart. The atmosphere at LIV is electrifying. The energy is palpable and you can feel it as soon as you step on the dance floor. The atmosphere is what makes the nightclub the ultimate destination for the elite crowd.

Unbeatable Location: The Ultimate Destination
---------------------------------------------

LIV’s location is unbeatable. The club is located in the heart of [Miami Beach](https://thekaskadeshotel.com/an-insiders-guide-to-the-best-things-to-do-in-miami-beach/), making it easily accessible from anywhere in the city. The club is housed in the Fontainebleau Hotel, which is a destination in itself.

With [chic accommodations](https://thekaskadeshotel.com/rooms/) and outstanding facilities, the [Kaskades SOBE](https://thekaskadeshotel.com/amenities/) is a renowned destination for an unparalleled stay in Miami Beach. From the plush accommodations to the impressive amenities, all your needs are met for an unparalleled stay. And to top it all off, the LIV nightclub is in close proximity to your ultimate vacation experience.

ABOUT DAVID GRUTMAN
-------------------

![Image 5: Man wearing a white shirt and black pants sits in an office space with large windows](https://groothospitality.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/Dave2-3.jpg)

 David Grutman’s influence and impact extend beyond the Miami scene as Groot Hospitality’s dynamic and inventive restaurants and nightclubs have made their mark on the hospitality industry. With decades of experience under his belt, 2025 will mark the first full year of Groot Hospitality’s expansion to Las Vegas, with two West Coast outposts of his most “seen and be seen” restaurants, the buzzy and vibrant Southeast Asian hotspot, Komodo, and Papi Steak, an intimate yet high-octane spin on the classic steakhouse. Both restaurants have already earned praise and recognition as “Best New Restaurants in Las Vegas.” LIV has also made its way into the discerning Las Vegas nightlife scene with an impressive roster of A-list talent, striking architecture and technology, further cementing LIV’s legacy as the ultimate nightlife destination. LIV Beach, Groot Hospitality’s foray into Las Vegas daylife, debuted this spring, the upscale poolside bacchanal draws inspiration from the French Riviera and boasts the same chart-topping lineup of the hottest names in EDM, hip-hop, and beyond as its nightlife counterpart. Komodo, Papi Steak, LIV Las Vegas, and LIV Beach call the Strip’s newest hotel-casino jewel, Fontainebleau Las Vegas, home. The resort was one of the city’s most anticipated openings in recent history and was even named one of TIME Magazine’s “World’s Greatest Places” within its first year of operations. 

 With a gregarious attitude and knack for setting trends, Grutman has amassed an impressive portfolio of one-of-kind ventures, including Miami’s Gekkō, in partnership with global sensation, Bad Bunny; Casadonna with Tao Group Hospitality; Komodo; celebrity favorite Papi Steak with partner, David “Papi” Einhorn; and LIV, one of the most iconic nightclubs in the world. Komodo Dallas was Groot Hospitality’s first property outside of Florida, bringing Miami’s cachet to the Lone Star State. 

 Outside of Groot Hospitality, Grutman also pursues additional business and personal ventures, including his work as the creative director and co-owner of Prince, the athletics and lifestyle company. The Miami-based entrepreneur is also a proud investor in a handful of successful consumer brands, including SkinnyDipped, Vacation, Goodles, and many more that he integrates into his ecosystem. Additionally, Grutman teaches a guest class at Florida International University’s School of Hospitality and Tourism, “The David Grutman Experience,” focusing on the conceptualization and creation of hospitality ventures, as well as Grutman’s candid view of his path to success. 

 What’s next for the serial entrepreneur? He has planted his stake in film and television with his own production company, DGN Studios, focusing on original content and documentaries around his entrepreneurial IP and the entertainment space. In 2025 and beyond, expect multiple new national and international Groot Hospitality venues.

THE DEFINITIVE MIAMI NIGHTLIFE EXPERIENCE
-----------------------------------------

LIV at Fontainebleau, consistently ranked one of the top nightlife venues in the world, reopened after a $10 million renovation to kick off the nightclub’s tenth season. LIV has redefined nightlife on Miami Beach and pioneered the nightlife experience. David Grutman owner of Groot Hospitality, retained acclaimed experiential design firm ICRAVE to oversee the transformation. With over 18,000 square feet of striking architecture, soaring ceilings, vibrant lighting and its iconic dome. LIV will continue to set the stage for the ultimate nightlife experience.

LIV has been updated to reflect the latest in technology and design in the nightlife industry. The physical and technological upgrades incorporate the latest and greatest available including maximizing the historic ‘bones’ of the space and have transformed the iconic dome and steel truss – affectionately referred to as ‘The Spider’. LIV has become an even more immersive and energetic nightclub environment. This, along with a general refresh of the look and materials, and the introduction of projection mapping in the space, have further cemented LIV as the go-to club in Miami and beyond.

LIV’s footprint stands in the home of the world-renowned Tropigala Lounge, known in the 50’s and 60’s as the La Ronde Room. Frank Sinatra was the first to illuminate the stage, followed by the likes of Sammy Davis Jr., Ann Miller, Elvis Presley and Tony Bennet. LIV has once again made the space an epicenter for style, fame and glamour.

26.content:
LIV Nightclub in Miami Beach enforces a strict dress code to maintain its upscale atmosphere. Proper attire is required, and the venue reserves the right to deny entry at the doorman’s discretion.

**Prohibited Attire:**  
• Tank tops  
• Sleeveless t-shirts  
• Shorts  
• Excessively baggy clothing  
• Sandals, flip-flops, or dirty athletic sneakers  
• Flats (for ladies)  
• Beach attire  
• Extra baggy tees  
• Jerseys or athletic wear  
• Hats

For gentlemen, it’s advisable to wear a collared shirt and pants, as shorts and sleeveless shirts are forbidden. Ladies should opt for appropriate attire, with heels being required; flats, sandals, and beachwear are not permitted.

To ensure a smooth entry, guests are encouraged to dress to impress and adhere closely to these guidelines.

_Venue open to public from Thursday – Sunday._

### Hours of Operation

*   **Monday:** Closed
*   **Tuesday:** Closed
*   **Wednesday:** Closed
*   **Thursday:** 11:00 PM – 5:00 AM
*   **Friday:** 11:00 PM – 5:00 AM
*   **Saturday:** 11:00 PM – 5:00 AM
*   **Sunday:** 11:00 PM – 5:00 AM

_Available seven days a week for private bookings._

See our [calendar](https://www.livnightclub.com/miami/events/) for upcoming events.

Guests must be 21 years of age or older to enter. A valid, physical government-issued photo ID is required—photos or digital copies will not be accepted.

Acceptable forms of ID include a U.S. driver’s license or any passport (U.S. or international) recognized by U.S. authorities.

Non-U.S. residents must present a valid passport. Foreign government-issued IDs (other than passports) will not be accepted.

04/

**WHAT TYPE OF MUSIC IS FEATURED AT LIV?**

LIV Nightclub in Miami Beach offers a dynamic music experience that varies throughout the week, featuring genres such as electronic dance music (EDM), hip-hop, and Top 40 hits. The specific music format depends on the night and the performing artists. For instance, during Miami Music Week 2025, LIV hosted performances by artists like Tiësto, Black Coffee, Axwell, Kaskade, Shimza, and 50 Cent, showcasing a blend of EDM and hip-hop. Similarly, during Art Basel 2024, LIV featured an impressive lineup that included Rick Ross, Offset, Diplo, DJ Khaled, John Summit, and Lil Wayne.

These events highlight LIV’s commitment to bringing world-class talent and diverse musical experiences to its guests. To get the most accurate and up-to-date information on the music genre or lineup for a particular night, it’s advisable to check LIV’s official [event calendar](https://www.livnightclub.com/miami/events/).

If you’ve lost or forgotten an item at Fontainebleau Miami Beach, you can contact the hotel’s Lost & Found team by calling their main line at 800-548-8886. For items lost at LIV Nightclub, please email [**lostandfound@livnightclub.com**](mailto:lostandfound@livnightclub.com) with a description of the item, the date it was lost, and your contact information. A team member will follow up with you regarding your inquiry.

All ticket sales are final and non-refundable. Tickets are non-transferable and cannot be exchanged or transferred to another event or individual. In the event of a cancellation without a rescheduled date, a full refund will be automatically issued to the original form of payment. By purchasing a ticket, you agree to this policy. Please confirm the event title, date, time, and location before completing your purchase.

To ensure a seamless experience at LIV Nightclub Miami, please adhere to the following ticketing guidelines:

*   Authorized Purchase Channels: Tickets must be purchased directly through LIV Nightclub’s official website. Purchasing tickets from unauthorized third-party platforms may result in invalid tickets and denial of entry.
*   Non-Transferable Tickets: Tickets are non-transferable and cannot be exchanged or transferred to another individual or event. Each ticket is valid only for the original purchaser and the specified event.
*   Verification at Entry: Upon arrival, you will be required to present a valid government-issued photo ID that matches the name on the ticket. Failure to provide matching identification may result in denial of entry.
*   Final Sale Policy: All ticket sales are final. No refunds or exchanges will be provided, except in the event of a cancellation without a rescheduled date, in which case a full refund will be automatically issued to the original form of payment.

Table reservation costs at LIV Nightclub vary based on the event, talent, and table location.

To view upcoming events, see real-time pricing, and purchase tables directly, please visit our [**Upcoming Events Page**](https://www.livnightclub.com/miami/events/).

LIV Nightclub
-------------

4441 Collins Ave, Miami Beach, FL 33140, United States

David Grutman attends day one of TAO, Beauty + Essex, Avenue + Luchini LA Grand Opening on March 16, 2017 in Los Angeles.Michael Kovac/Getty Images for TAO

When you’re a don of Miami nightlife with a couple nightclubs to your name, plus a trendy Japanese restaurant, a donut shop, a coffee house and a plant-based eatery, what else is there to do but gather all your investments under one hospitality group of your own invention?

David Grutman is exactly one such man. He got his start in the Miami entertainment industry when he opened LIV nightclub on South Beach, a high-end establishment in the famous Fontainebleau hotel. LIV is known worldwide for booking top [dance](https://www.billboard.com/t/dance/) music talent and luring celebrities, and renowned for its weekly Sunday hip-hop party, name dropped by rappers [Lil Wayne](https://www.billboard.com/music/lil-wayne), [Kanye West](https://www.billboard.com/music/kanye-west), [Drake](https://www.billboard.com/music/drake) and more.

The entrepreneur expanded his empire with SoBe sister club Story, then broke into the restaurant business with Komodo in Miami’s Brickell neighborhood, followed shortly by OTL coffee house, Planta’s locally-sourced plant-based eatery and Happy Place Donuts. Now, Grutman announces he’ll house all his businesses under the banner of Groot Hospitality.

“Years ago with MMG, I set out to change traditional marketing,” Grutman says in a press release.“With the launch of Groot Hospitality, we have transitioned from a marketing firm to a lifestyle hospitality collective, owning and operating our venues. We will continue to show our guests out-of-the-box exciting ideas and concepts. Our new company will have something for everyone — I want people dining in my restaurants, drinking at my coffee shops, partying in my clubs and eventually sleeping in my guest rooms.”

It’s just another bold move by Miami’s king of kings. It’s also only the beginning, as Grutman plans to expand his brand into other cities around the country and the world.
